1 Rectangles
The area of a rectangle is the product of its sides; swapping the sides keeps it.
theorem Rect.area_swap (r : Rect) : { w := r.h, h := r.w }.area = r.area
As mathematics:
|rh × rw| = |r|
The host’s own executable, a module named Main like the extractor’s, is the
one the paper sees:
def main : IO Unit
